sections.h2: A journal that follows the Moon
p: Every month the Moon moves from new to full and back again. Many people use this rhythm for journaling: at the new moon they write down an intention, at the full moon they look back and note what they are grateful for.

We calculate the exact moment of every new and full moon with the Swiss Ephemeris and find the house of your birth chart where it falls. Each house has its own theme, so your questions change from month to month instead of repeating the same list.

sections.h2: What this is and what it is not
p: These are questions for reflection, not predictions. We do not tell you what will happen; we offer a rhythm, a few questions and an affirmation, and the answers are yours.
Your answers are saved in your journal so you can find them on any device. We also keep your email and birth data for the letters. You can delete everything at any time with one click.

faq.q: When is the next new moon?
faq.a: The table on this page lists every new and full moon until the end of 2027 with the exact time, and the next one is highlighted.

faq.q: Do I need my birth time?
faq.a: No. Without a birth time we count the houses from your Sun sign. With your birth time and place we count them from your rising sign, which is more personal.

faq.q: What should I write at the new moon?
faq.a: One intention in the present tense and one small step for the coming days. Your personal questions depend on the house where the new moon falls in your chart.

faq.q: What should I write at the full moon?
faq.a: Look back over the last two weeks and name three things you are grateful for. Your letter adds two questions for the house of the full moon.
Yes. The calculator and the letters are free, and every letter has a link to unsubscribe.

plans.title: Free letters, and a personal month if you want more
plans.lead: We do not predict events. We send you questions at the moments the Moon changes phase, and keep your answers so you can look back.
plans.freeIntro: On the day of each new and full moon you get a short email: the area of your chart where that Moon falls, three questions and an affirmation. You answer on a private page; it takes about five minutes.

freeItems.title: Which area of life this Moon touches
freeItems.text: Love, home, work, rest: each time the Moon falls in a different area of your chart, explained in plain words.

freeItems.title: Three questions to answer
freeItems.text: One about what you want, one about what has changed, one to carry forward. Short enough for a busy day.

freeItems.title: Your answers, kept together
freeItems.text: Everything you write is saved in one private journal, so you can reread past months and notice what keeps coming back.

plans.freeClosing: Free, two emails a month. Unsubscribe in one click.
plans.paidIntro: A calendar of your month, built from your birth chart: which days bring which themes, with a question for each, and at the end of the month a look back at what you wrote.

paidItems.title: Your dates for the month
paidItems.text: The days when the planets touch your chart most strongly, and which part of life each one concerns: work, relationships, home or your inner life.

paidItems.title: A question for each period
paidItems.text: Not instructions: one question per period to help you decide for yourself.

paidItems.title: A review of your entries
paidItems.text: At the end of the month we put your entries next to the sky of those days, so recurring needs and themes become visible.

paidItems.title: Your year as a story
paidItems.text: On your birthday, those months become a private yearbook: not a list of predictions, but a portrait of how you changed.

plans.paidClosing: For people who want to see the whole month, not only two moments in it.
plans.exampleNote: Example for a fictional person born on 17 May 1990. Your own month is calculated from your birth data.

calendar.what: Venus meets your Sun — visibility and self-worth
calendar.text: Compliments may land more deeply this week, or you may notice the moments when you play yourself down. Pay attention to the clothes, people and choices that make you feel more like yourself — not simply more acceptable.
calendar.question: Where are you ready to stop asking for permission to enjoy being yourself?

calendar.what: Mars activates your 4th house — home and belonging
calendar.text: You may feel an urge to clear a corner, address a tension at home or ask for more room of your own. Rather than changing everything, notice the one place — or relationship — that no longer lets you exhale.
calendar.question: If your home could support the person you are becoming, what would you change first, and why?

calendar.what: Full Moon in your 10th house — work and recognition
calendar.text: A result, deadline or conversation may make your progress visible. Before rushing to the next goal, notice what you have built — and whether the version of success you are chasing still feels like yours.
calendar.question: What are you proud to claim as your own, and whose approval are you ready to stop measuring it by?

plans.reviewTitle: Your month in your own words
review: Across seven November entries, three words keep returning: “rest”, “sister” and “project”. Your private life and visible work seem to be asking for attention at the same time.

Near the full moon in your 10th house you wrote: “I want my work to be seen, but not at the cost of coming home depleted.” The same tension appeared in August, when Jupiter crossed the top of your chart.
Carry into December: what would visible success look like if it also left room for your real life?

lunationPage.housesTitle: Where it falls in your chart
lunationPage.housesLead: The same Moon touches a different area of life depending on your rising sign, the sign that was rising when you were born. Find yours in the table. If you do not know it, use your Sun sign instead.

signs.about: The sign of beginnings, courage and acting on an honest impulse.
new: What would you start this month if you did not wait for the perfect moment?
Where do you want a little more courage, and what is the first small move?
full: What did you dare to begin recently, and what is it giving you?
Where did you follow an honest impulse, and what did it show you?

signs.about: The sign of the body, the senses, steadiness and what you truly value.
new: What simple pleasure do you want to make room for this month?
What would help your days feel steadier and less rushed?
full: What have you built slowly that you can appreciate now?
Which ordinary comfort mattered to you over the last two weeks?

signs.about: The sign of curiosity, conversation, learning and the many small exchanges of a day.
new: What would you like to learn or explore out of pure curiosity?
Which conversation would you like to start, and with whom?
full: Which idea or conversation stayed with you recently, and why?
What did you understand about yourself thanks to someone's words?

signs.about: The sign of home, belonging and care, for others and for yourself.
new: What would make your home, or your inner home, feel warmer and safer?
How would you like to care for yourself this month?
full: Who made you feel at home recently, and how?
Which feeling has been asking for your care lately?

signs.about: The sign of joy, creativity, generosity and the wish to show yourself fully.
new: What would you create this month if no one were grading it?
Where would you like to show up more as yourself?
full: What gave you pride or a real sense of being alive recently?
Where did your warmth or generosity make a difference?

signs.about: The sign of daily rhythm, careful work and the small habits that keep life in order.
new: Which small daily habit would make the biggest gentle difference?
What could you simplify or put in order this month?
full: Which routine was a good support over the last weeks?
What did you do with care that deserves your own recognition?

signs.about: The sign of relationships, balance, fairness and beauty.
new: What balance would you like between giving and receiving?
Which relationship would you like to tend with more attention?
full: Where did you find a good balance recently, and what helped?
Which connection are you grateful for right now?

signs.about: The sign of depth, trust, honesty with yourself and inner change.
new: What can you let go of to make room for something new?
Where would you like to trust a little more, yourself included?
full: What truth about yourself became clearer recently?
What has quietly changed in you since the last new moon?

signs.about: The sign of horizons, meaning, travel, study and hope.
new: What would you like to explore, learn or see with fresh eyes?
Which belief or hope do you want to guide your choices this month?
full: What widened your view of life recently?
What are you more hopeful about today than a month ago?

signs.about: The sign of goals, patience, responsibility and building something that lasts.
new: Which long-term goal deserves one concrete step this month?
What structure or boundary would support what you are building?
full: What progress, even slow, can you acknowledge today?
Which responsibility did you carry well, and how?

signs.about: The sign of friendship, community, freedom and fresh ideas.
new: Which idea feels new and exciting to you right now?
Which community or friendship would you like to nourish?
full: Who in your circle inspired you recently?
Where did you find room to be yourself without fitting in?

signs.about: The sign of imagination, compassion, rest and the inner world.
new: What does your inner world need more of this month: rest, silence or imagination?
Which dream would you like to give a little room?
full: When did you feel connected to something larger than yourself recently?
What did rest or quiet give you over the last weeks?
